title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform-vault-sealed-secrets
author: Lucas Chen
release_notes: Automates TLS and KMS/HSM key rotation for private deployments using Vault and SealedSecrets; updates Helm and Terraform modules; adds upgrade/rollback safety checks.
description: Summary: Adds automation for certificate and key rotation in private deployments (VPC/on-prem) integrating Vault, SealedSecrets, and HSM-backed KMS. This PR updates the private-installer Helm charts and Terraform modules, extends the installer upgrade/rollback tooling to support zero-downtime TLS rotations, and includes end-to-end tests and docs for operator runbooks. Motivation: Customers running Private mode need automated, auditable certificate and key rotation compliant with security policies and minimal operational load. Previous manual rotation steps were error-prone and caused brief downtime during key rollover or required manual secret re-encryption. This work closes ENG-4682 and addresses SUP-3421 incident follow-ups. What changed (high level): - New terraform module redwood_kms_connector to provision KMS keys, HSM connector config, and Vault transit key wiring. - Helm chart changes: values for enableAutoRotation, rotationWindow, vaultTransitPath, sealedSecretsSecretName. - Installer upgrade flow: a new pre-check that validates KMS/HSM connectivity and a staged rotation plan that can be rolled back if health checks fail. - SealedSecrets integration: automated re-encryption pipeline using sealed-secrets-controller with Vault-transit backed unsealer for air-gapped clusters. - Tests: e2e test harness added to perf-canary that simulates rotation with live Vault in CI, plus unit tests for terraform module inputs and helm template rendering. Commits (summary): - commit 1: scaffold redwood_kms_connector terraform module, initial resources and outputs - commit 2: add helm values and template hooks for rotation controllers, docs and defaults - commit 3: installer: add staged rotation orchestration and rollback hooks - commit 4: sealed-secrets automation scripts + kubectl job manifests to re-seal secrets post-rotation - commit 5: e2e tests and CI pipeline updates - commit 6: address review feedback, improve error handling and logs Key files changed (high level): - terraform/modules/redwood_kms_connector/main.tf (new) - terraform/modules/redwood_kms_connector/outputs.tf (new) - private-installer/helm/values-schema.yaml - private-installer/helm/templates/rotation-controller.yaml - private-installer/installer/upgrade/rotation-orchestrator.go - private-installer/installer/upgrade/rollback-handler.go - private-installer/scripts/reseal-with-vault.sh - private-installer/tests/e2e/rotation-flow.test.ts - docs/private-installer/rotation-runbook.md - charts/sealed-secrets/templates/unsealer-vault.yaml Notes on implementation details: - KMS/HSM: The terraform module creates a customer-managed key in the configured KMS and outputs a key identifier. For HSM-backed flows the module configures the HSM connector resource and writes a bootstrap secret (encrypted) that the installer picks up at install time. - Vault integration: We wire Vault transit for re-encryption and use Vault's PKI for short-lived certificates when enabled. The installer supports both: (a) self-managed Vault referenced by address/token OR (b) integrated Vault provisioned by terraform module (opt-in). - SealedSecrets: Post-rotation, the reseal script calls Vault transit to encrypt plaintext secrets and applies new SealedSecrets resources. For air-gapped clusters we support an offline reseal mode where the operator runs the reseal job locally and uploads the result. - Upgrade safety: Rotation orchestrator runs in stages: dry-run -> apply to subset (canary) -> monitor health -> full rollout. If any stage fails health or latency SLOs, rollback-handler re-applies previous certs and KMS keys and aborts. Test plan and results: - Unit tests: terraform plan validation (passed) - Helm lint/render tests (passed) - Integration: CI runs e2e rotation scenario against a disposable Vault cluster. First run had a flaky integration test (vault auth timeout) which was retried; subsequent run passed. CI summary: build: pass, unit-tests: pass, integration-e2e: pass (2nd run), lint: pass, security-scan: pass. Review discussion (high level): - Priya Patel (reviewer): Requested stronger logging around key id rotations and a non-destructive dry-run flag for the reseal script. Also asked to validate that rollback path does not leak old secrets. - Lucas Chen (author): Implemented enhanced structured logs and added --dry-run to reseal script; added unit tests around rollback to ensure no orphaned SealedSecrets. - Miguel Torres (reviewer): Asked for clearer Helm values documentation and default behavior with Vault disabled. - Lucas Chen: Expanded values-schema.yaml and docs/private-installer/rotation-runbook.md with examples for both Vault-enabled and Vault-disabled flows. - Sofia Nguyen (reviewer): Security review: requested HSM connector credentials be stored only in sealed secrets and added an audit event on rotation start/complete. - Lucas Chen: Updated terraform outputs to write HSM bootstrap secret as sealed secret, and added audit events to rotation orchestrator logs. Merge rationale and process: Approved by Priya, Miguel, and Sofia after two rounds of changes. CI green. Merged via squash on release/v1.18 to keep history concise. Rollout plan: This change is gated by a feature flag (values.enableAutoRotation) defaulting to false. Ops can enable per-cluster after validating KMS/Vault connectivity. Runbook: docs/private-installer/rotation-runbook.md includes step-by-step operator instructions, rollback commands, and post-rotation validation checks. Backwards compatibility: Non-breaking by default (feature flag off). Existing users not using Vault/SealedSecrets are unaffected. Customers using manual rotations can opt-in. Known limitations and follow-ups: - We do not yet automate rotation for legacy service accounts requiring manual mapping; follow-up ENG-4720 will add a mapping tool. - HSM connector provisioning currently supports the three major vendors; additional vendor support via partner integrations is tracked. Attachments: - scripts, test outputs, and example terraform plans included in commits. If you are testing locally: - Use the included docker-compose local-vault for e2e smoke testing - Run ./scripts/reseal-with-vault.sh --dry-run first - Validate helm template with: helm template ./private-installer/helm --values=example-values.yaml
